## History

Before living on the [Island](../codex/places.md#brendan-s-island), James A. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) resided in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). To ease the anxiety of his dying sister, he had promised her he would marry [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott. He later received a parrot named [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md) from his dying sailor brother, but after a dispute where [Emily](../character/emily.md) insisted he choose between her and the bird, she returned to her personal home, separating the couple.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P29](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0029), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058)_
